typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblGSFIMGENERICALLSTATUSMapping_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		book as string,
		inventory_name as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ImGenericAllstatus
ImGenericAllstatus derive({Copy of inventory_name} = inventory_name,
		{Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME} = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		{Copy of status} = status) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Status as string,
		Trading_Unit_Name as string,
		Inventory_Name as string,
		Book as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status = {Copy of status},
		Trading_Unit_Name = {Copy of TRADING_UNIT_NAME},
		Inventory_Name = {Copy of inventory_name},
		Book = book),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblGSFIMGENERICALLSTATUSMapping_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblGSFIMGENERICALLSTATUSMapping
